request.description: Grounded four-legged walk in place, diagonal paw pairs alternate with weight: BOTH wings flap DOWN TOGETHER then return to the reference highest pose, restrained downward arc only. Far rider leg stays hidden; near wing stays in FRONT of lower rider hair/body consistently, below the face. Never move a wing across the face. No extra limbs, symbols, background, speed lines, exterior magic or particles. Return seamlessly to reference pose.
